title: Brighouse Autonomy Security Lab: mavaudit, MAVLink signing measurements, and acceptance-semantics model
description: Defensive security research artifact for MAVLink-based drones and autonomous systems, aligned to the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). Includes: mavaudit (a key-less MAVLink configuration auditor with CRA-mapped findings), a parameterised acceptance-semantics formal model with bounded adversary exploration and design-space synthesis, a model-based conformance harness (47 recorded model-vs-implementation decisions across three stacks and four link configurations), a reproducible and versioned secure-by-default score, and measured software-in-the-loop results for ArduPilot 4.7.2 and PX4 v1.17.0 / v1.18.0-rc1. Measurements include the channel-0 unsigned-accept exemption (shown to follow the channel index rather than the transport), the surface served to an unauthenticated peer per release, and the unauthenticated uXRCE-DDS control plane that a MAVLink signing key does not protect. All probes are read-only and run against local simulators; the artifact contains no exploit code and no attack automation.
notes: Preprints, not peer-reviewed. Measurements are of software-in-the-loop builds, not of physical aircraft; no Remote ID broadcast or CAN-bus measurement is included, and the repository states this where the question arises.
